summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialized in __init__ and set/cleared in run()'s run_app coroutine via try/finally. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 8 tests; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src (the venv otherwise imports a separate base checkout). Non-snapshot suite: 613 passed, 68 failed; all 68 failures are async tests lacking pytest-asyncio in the prepared venv, not verified against a pre-change baseline. Nothing committed.
